results.description:
TinyBitAI: the elderly care app for families who care from anywhere
Living in another city, or another country, doesn’t mean caring less. TinyBit is a family care
app and elder care app that helps you support your elderly parents and loved ones with
safety, health information and daily connection, all in one place. As a family safety app and
parent safety app, it supports remote elderly care and long-distance caregiving while
respecting consent and independence. If you’re searching for apps for parental monitoring,
TinyBit keeps everything consent-based, so your loved one always stays in touch.
Whether your parents live alone in India or you’re an NRI family far from home, TinyBit gives
you care from anywhere and gives them a companion that’s always there.
BUILT FOR FAMILIES, WHEREVER YOU ARE
● Families in another city. You work in one city while your parents are in another.
Stay informed about their safety, health and routine without constant calls. 
● NRI families. Living in the UAE, USA, UK, Canada, Australia or in any other part of the
world? Care for your parents in India from a distance with location sharing (with
consent), SOS support, health records and daily updates in one app.
● Parents living alone. Give your loved one an emergency plan, medicine reminders
and a private companion to talk to, while they keep their independence, all in one
senior care app.
● Siblings sharing care. Keep health records and emergency details in one place, so
everyone works from the same information.
● Organizing care for any family member. Store medical reports, understand them in
simple language and keep emergency information ready.
Whether you live 20 kilometres away or 6,000, TinyBit helps you care from anywhere.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH TINYBIT
Location Sharing, With Consent
Safe location sharing for elderly parents, with permission. Your loved one stays in control
of what is shared and who can see it. It’s family safety without losing independence.
SOS Emergency Support
One tap and a 5-second countdown reach the emergency contacts you’ve set up. It’s an
emergency support app for elderly parents who live alone, with guardians and contacts
that are easy to manage.
Emergency Health QR
Create a secure QR code with medical information, allergies, medications and emergency
details, ready when every second matters.
Health Vault & AI Health Insights
A health records app for family. Store medical reports, prescriptions and health records
digitally, and get AI-powered insights and trends in one organised place.
Medicine Reminder
A medicine reminder app for elderly parents that helps them stay on routine, without
constant phone calls from you.
Guardian
Trusted family and friends stay in the loop when your loved one updates their mood or
completes a task, in a gentle way that respects their space.
Report Checker
Medical reports explained in simple language. Upload a report and get a clear summary so
you can follow health patterns and prepare for doctor visits.
Talk With Me & Chat With Me
A private, non-judgmental AI companion your loved one can talk or type to anytime, for
everyday conversation, stress and loneliness.
Mood Assessment
A quick check-in that reads mood and energy from a photo and suggests simple actions to
restore balance.
Calorie Calculator
Snap a meal to see calories, protein, fats and nutrition in seconds, to support healthy daily
habits.
Download TinyBit AI, the elderly care app and senior care app for Iphone and stay
close, wherever you are.
TinyBit is a companion app and not a medical device. AI insights are informational and don’t
replace professional medical advice. Location sharing requires user consent.

Look after someone long enough and the same questions keep coming back: when was the last dose? Is the weight going up or down? Which vaccines are done?

Care Record keeps those answers, and shows you the trend.

■ Track anyone you look after
Pets, parents, kids, or yourself. Each one gets their own items and history.

■ Define the items yourself
Weight, medication, vet visits and vaccinations are built in — or create your own.
Fields can be numbers, text, multiple choice, dates or photos. Record whatever matters to you.

■ Two taps to log
Hit Record right on the care recipient or the item. No need to switch to the calendar and pick everything again.

■ See the change
Numeric items become line charts, count-based items become bar charts.
Whether the weight keeps climbing, how many doses this month — one glance.

■ Reminders where they belong
Set a reminder on the item itself. When it fires, tapping the notification takes you straight to logging.

■ Group them your way
As the list grows, sort recipients and items into your own groups. All pages filter together.

■ No sign-up required
Start straight away. Link Apple, Google or email later when you want to sync — your data comes with you.

Companio helps you care for an aging loved one from anywhere with daily AI companion calls, gentle medication check-ins, and a calm, easy-to-understand snapshot of their day.

Your loved one receives a warm, familiar voice that calls every day. You get peace of mind between your own calls and visits.

Companio is designed for families who want more than reminders, alerts, or complex dashboards. It starts with natural conversation — then helps you understand mood, medication, wellness, and health signals in simple, human language.


DAILY COMPANION CALLS
Companio calls your loved one every day for a natural, friendly check-in. Conversations can gently cover sleep, mood, medication, meals, and daily wellbeing.
No need to open an app — they simply answer the call.


A DAILY SNAPSHOT FOR YOU
After each check-in, caregivers receive a simple daily overview that may include:
• Mood and wellness notes
• Medication status
• Things to watch
• Plain-language conversation summaries
• Health signals (when Apple Watch is connected)
• Daily history and trends

No clinical jargon. No complicated dashboards. Just a clearer picture of how they’re doing.


MEDICATION, CHECKED IN GENTLY
Add medications your loved one needs to take. Companio can remind them naturally during the call and ask if they’ve taken them.
No alarms. No pressure. Just supportive conversation.


HEALTH SIGNALS WITH CONTEXT
With Apple Watch integration, Companio can show helpful health signals such as heart rate, steps, sleep, calories, exercise, ECG, and more.
Numbers make more sense when seen alongside the story of the day.
Apple Watch and HealthKit features require compatible devices and permissions. Available metrics may vary.


CHECK IN WHEN IT MATTERS
Need to follow up on something specific? You can guide a call with an agenda:
• Ask if medication was taken
• Check how they are feeling
• Remind them about an appointment
• Ask whether they ate
• Follow up on sleep, pain, or mood

Companio helps you stay involved without making every call feel like a task.


BUILT FOR WARMTH AND DIGNITY
Companio is designed to support care, not replace it.
It helps your loved one feel heard while helping you stay informed — without making them feel monitored.


SUBSCRIPTION
Companio offers auto-renable subscriptions:
• Monthly plan
• Yearly plan
• 7-day free trial available

• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period
• Account may be charged within 24 hours before renewal
• Manage or cancel anytime in Apple ID settings

Prices may vary by region.


IMPORTANT NOTE
Companio is not a medical device, emergency service, or substitute for professional care.
If you believe your loved one is in immediate danger, contact emergency services or a trusted caregiver directly.
Medication reminders and health insights are for supportive awareness only.

Support: https://mycompanio.app

Caring for someone you love, together with your family? With CareWall everyone knows what is going on and who does what, without endless messages and loose lists.

ONE CARE CIRCLE, EVERYONE IN THE LOOP
Create a care circle for your mother, father, grandma or grandpa and invite the family. Everyone sees the same: what happens today, what still needs doing and how things are going.

WHO DOES WHAT? EVERYONE KNOWS
• A shared schedule: add moments and let family members say who goes.
• A calendar with appointments at the GP, the hospital or the hairdresser.
• Tick off tasks and medication together, so nobody does anything twice or forgets.

NEED A HAND? ASK YOUR FAMILY
Ask for help with shopping, transport or a visit. Whoever can takes it on, and everyone sees it.

STAY CLOSE, EVEN FROM FAR AWAY
Share an update or a photo in the care feed, react to each other and chat with the whole care circle or one person.

ALL CARE DETAILS IN ONE PLACE
The care file with contacts, appointments, medical details and documents. Plus short courses (in Dutch) about caring for a loved one and an assistant that thinks along.

SAFE AND PRIVATE
Only the people you invite see your care circle.

FREE TO START
Start free with one care circle and two members. More family members or more care circles? Choose Family Pro: unlimited, with a 14-day free trial first.

FOR CARE PROFESSIONALS
Does your home care organisation use Nedap Ons? Then care professionals can use CareWall too, for their route, clients and reports.

CareWall is available in Dutch, English and Arabic.

results.description:
Health rarely belongs to one moment or one person. It unfolds across a family: a medication that has just changed, a symptom someone mentions in passing, a result that needs following up, or a question you wish you had asked at the appointment.

Lifelong gives families a calm, private place to hold that story together. Each person has their own health space, so medications, conditions, symptoms, records, appointments and everyday wellbeing stay connected to the person they belong to.

Whether you care for a parent across the world, support a partner through treatment or simply want a clearer picture of your own health, Lifelong helps everyone stay informed without losing the context that matters.

Before a consultation, gather questions, recent changes and the records you want to discuss. With everyone’s consent, record the conversation. Afterwards, keep the write-up, next steps and care plan together so important decisions do not disappear into memory, messages or scattered files.

Alo helps you explore the information your family chooses to keep in Lifelong. Ask about a symptom, medication change, health topic, recent result or pattern over time, and bring the relevant context into one clear conversation.

Wearables add another layer to the story. Connect Apple Health, Apple Watch, Oura and other compatible devices to follow sleep, activity, recovery and heart-rate trends alongside the rest of someone’s care journey not apart from it.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

Every person’s health information remains theirs. Data is encrypted, never sold and never used for ads. Families decide what to share and with whom.

ONE MEMBERSHIP FOR THE FAMILY

One Lifelong Plus membership covers everyone you invite. 

Lifelong is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Always speak with a qualified professional about your health.

JoyFamily – support your loved ones, wherever you are.

JoyFamily is the family companion app for JoyTV or JoyTablet. It makes it easy to video call an older parent, a grandparent or a loved one with IDD on their tablet or TV, with nothing for them to set up and nothing for them to press. Their screen can answer your call automatically, so you see them in seconds and get instant peace of mind.

Joy works with your loved one's favorite device:

• JoyTablet – turns an everyday tablet into a simple, always-on way to stay connected. Use a tablet you or they already own.
• JoyTV – a small device that plugs into their TV, for calls and photos on the biggest screen in the house.

JoyFamily is your control center. From your phone you can:

• Make video calls that can be answered automatically on their tablet or TV
• Meet Joy, their friendly AI assistant and companion, who chats, answers questions and keeps them company between calls
• Set up reminders for medications, appointments and daily routines, shown on their screen and read aloud by Joy
• Schedule check-ins with Joy and video check-ins, so you know how they are doing each day
• Send text messages and short videos straight to their screen
• Share family photos and manage their photo slideshow on JoyTablet, including how long each photo shows and when the clock appears
• Invite siblings, grandkids, friends and support staff so everyone can stay in touch
• Share YouTube videos, join Zoom visits, and sign them up for Live Events & Classes
• Control their TV and schedule Night Mode, depending on their device

Who it's for:

• Adult children and spouses caring for an older loved one
• Families and support staff caring for adults with IDD
• Long-distance families who want to stay close
• Senior-living communities, group homes, home-health agencies and IDD service providers

Getting started takes a few minutes:

1. Create your account and tell us about your loved one.
2. Choose the screen they will use: on a tablet with JoyTablet, or on their TV with JoyTV.
3. Install JoyTablet on their tablet and log in once, or follow the on-screen steps to connect JoyTV. That's it.

Already invited by a family member? Tap "I have an invitation code" to join them.

Live help is built in. Tap the Help icon in the app to chat with our friendly customer care team.

ONSCREEN JoyFamily – easy, safe and fun communication for seniors, people with IDD and their families.

results.releaseNotes:
Reminders now work properly.
  If you added a medicine while setting up Family OS, its reminder wasn't being scheduled. That's
  fixed — and existing medicines are repaired automatically when you open the app.
  Reminders could also cancel each other out. An appointment alert could quietly replace a medicine
  one. Every reminder now keeps its own place.
  Times were showing incorrectly. A symptom logged at 9:48pm appeared as 4:18pm. All your past
  entries now read correctly too.
  New: gentle daily check-ins. Three quiet nudges a day to help you keep your family's picture
  complete. Turn them off any time in Settings.
  Also: ask for meal ideas and tap "Get ingredients" to pick the one you want to cook. Your doctor
  summary now shows dates for every entry.
